name: Ariel
summary: Ariel is a close personal friend in Miami who texts about Art Basel, Blondish, Circo Loco, NYE plans, and Bankroll events. She's a content creator/influencer who was considered for brand deals (Nylon, Eden Art Alec Monopoly Miami) and asked about the trading course. In Oct 2026 she asked about selling a 128k-follower Instagram account she overpaid $6,500 for; the owner advised it's only worth $1,200-$1,500 private or $900-$1,100 wholesale. No paid services exchanged, but she may want help selling the account.
